title: review-route input
description: Input envelope consumed by `plan_ops.py review-route`. Encodes the parsed Phase D review state for one task: who implemented, the reviewer envelope, the optional D.5 third-opinion envelope, retry budget consumed so far on this task, and routing flags. The subcommand maps this to one routing directive — see review_route_output_schema.json.

task_id.description: Three-digit task id (`NNN` or `NNN<A-Z>`). Round-tripped into the directive so dispatch templates have it.

implementer.description: Which implementer produced the work under review. Drives D.2 / D.2a vs D.2b dispatch (Claude-impl → Codex-review escalates via D.5; Codex-impl → Claude-review escalates via role-swap).

reviewer_envelope.description: Parsed review envelope. `verdict` vocabulary depends on reviewer: Codex reviewer emits `clean|minor-findings|needs-rework`; Claude reviewer emits `ship|ship-with-fixes|needs-rework`.

d5_envelope.description: Phase D.5 third-opinion envelope when D.2a fired; `null` when no D.5 dispatch happened. `verdict` is one of `ship|ship-with-fixes|partial-agreement|needs-rework`. `load_bearing` and `dismissed` carry the index split for the `partial-agreement` path.

retries_used.description: Per-task retry budget consumed prior to this routing call. Each is one-shot; `true` means the budget is exhausted.

flags.description: Routing-affecting flags surfaced from CLI / SKILL state.

codex_review_binding.description: When `true` and reviewer is Codex on Claude work with `needs-rework`, route straight to `fail` — no D.5, no remediation.

skip_cross_review.description: Reserved; reviewer envelope still drives routing in v1.
